Dear Atlas Mutual team,

I read that Atlas Mutual launched online claim tracking for members this year. Claims that members can follow online are the kind of feature I would like to work on.

I am a junior software engineer at Tessellate Labs with two years of experience in TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL. I built the React admin screens for refunds and credit notes and maintain the invoicing service.

Could we set up a short call?

Best regards,
Rania Haroon

Dear Atlas Mutual team,

In my first month at Tessellate I shipped a migration that renamed a column without a fallback, and the admin screen went blank. My lead didn't shout. She asked me to write up what happened and to add the expand-then-contract step to our migration checklist.

A member checking a claim online deserves the same care, which is why the Claims work at Atlas Mutual appeals to me. I have two years of TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL behind me, and I cut our nightly reconciliation job from 41 minutes to 6.

Could we set up a short call?

Best regards,
Rania Haroon
